answer: One concrete protocol: each agent must burn a verifiable token of real value, like onyx, to register an identity, and that stake is slashed if collusion is detected. Honest peers then reward sustained contribution with nectar, a non-transferable reputation token earned over epochs. A new identity starts as a mirror of zero history, so faking many accounts costs repeated onyx burns with no nectar upside, making sybil farming economically irrational.
